findings.title: verify:repo rejects Node's built-in test module
findings.claim: verify:repo reports the built-in module node:test as an undeclared package and exits nonzero
findings.observed: The command exits 1 and reports node:test as undeclared in existing test files; Node's builtinModules list here includes neither test nor node:test.
findings.invariant: new: repository verification accepts Node built-in modules
findings.fix: Recognize node: built-ins when checking imports, including node:test.

findings.title: safe-run allows git bisect to execute an unchecked command
findings.observed: The witness fails because the guard returns ok: true for git bisect run with a destructive command targeting outside the project.
findings.fix: Block command-executing Git subcommands and their execution options, including bisect run and rebase -x.

findings.title: Quoted credential values containing spaces bypass redaction
findings.claim: ∃ credential value containing spaces: maskSecrets preserves its full value
findings.observed: The witness fails: maskSecrets leaves the space-containing quoted credential value in its result.
findings.fix: Redact the entire quoted credential value, including whitespace, without requiring a whitespace-free token.

findings.title: Saving credentials preserves permissive existing file modes
findings.claim: On POSIX, saving credentials to an existing mode-0644 file leaves its mode at 0644
findings.observed: The witness observes mode 0644 (420) after saveCredentials, rather than owner-only mode 0600 (384).
findings.fix: Enforce owner-only permissions for existing credentials files as well as newly created ones.

findings.title: An unrelated decision can satisfy Gemini privacy consent
findings.claim: A decision titled "Gemini privacy feature discussion" with selected="yes" makes hasGeminiConsent return true
findings.observed: The witness fails because hasGeminiConsent returns true for the unrelated decision.
findings.invariant: new: Gemini transmission requires a recorded matching consent decision
findings.fix: Require the canonical consent decision identity and affirmative selection, rather than title substrings.

findings.title: Claim status changes can skip documented lifecycle steps
findings.claim: An ASSUMPTION can transition directly from OPEN to SUPPORTED without entering TESTING
findings.observed: The witness fails with Missing expected exception; the reducer accepts OPEN -> SUPPORTED.
findings.fix: Validate status changes against the current claim status and the allowed transition relation in docs/spec.md.
